author: richburdon
principle: Type a callback using the consuming prop's handler type (e.g. NonNullable<Props['onChange']>) instead of writing out the parameter types by hand.
fix_shape: annotate the callback with the derived prop type instead of a manually duplicated signature

author: wittjosiah
principle: A wrapper component that should not affect layout should render as a Fragment rather than a DOM element.
fix_shape: replace the wrapping element with a Fragment so no extra node is added to the DOM

author: wittjosiah
principle: A foundational/framework package must not take a dependency on a specific external UI library for something it could implement itself.
fix_shape: remove the dependency and implement the needed primitive locally instead of importing it from a UI library

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Reuse existing test setup/helper code from a sibling test suite instead of re-implementing the same logic in a new test utility file.
fix_shape: import or copy the shared helper from the existing test source instead of writing a fresh implementation

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not enumerate multiple dated/versioned constants when a canonical alias (e.g. 'latest') already covers the need.
fix_shape: remove the specific dated version entries and keep only the latest/canonical alias

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Before building a new client/adapter, check whether an existing one already covers the use case and extend or reuse it instead of writing a parallel implementation.
fix_shape: reuse/extend the existing compatible client instead of introducing a new one for the same protocol

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Wire the real service layer into test/dev scaffolding rather than a stripped-down substitute when the real one is available.
fix_shape: pass the real layer into the test/service setup instead of a mocked or minimal stand-in

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Wire the real service layer into test/dev scaffolding rather than a stripped-down substitute when the real one is available, following the canonical existing usage elsewhere in the codebase.
fix_shape: use the same real layer construction already used in the referenced canonical location instead of a mocked one

author: richburdon
principle: Do not rename a destructured parameter/option unnecessarily; keep the destructured name matching its original source name.
fix_shape: destructure to the same name as the source field instead of introducing a renamed alias

author: wittjosiah
principle: Do not leave raw console.log debugging statements in committed code; use the project's structured logger instead.
fix_shape: remove the console.log or replace it with the structured log module

author: richburdon
principle: Group cross-cutting components shared across multiple commands/features into a dedicated shared location instead of leaving them scattered per-feature.
fix_shape: create/use a shared folder for the cross-cutting components and move the files there

author: richburdon
principle: Use a single, consistent logging mechanism throughout the codebase rather than mixing an ad hoc console-style API with the project logger.
fix_shape: standardize on one logging API instead of switching between it and Console/console calls

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Reuse an existing typed accessor/cast helper instead of writing a fresh inline cast to reach an internal property.
fix_shape: call the existing helper function instead of inlining a new `as any`/manual cast

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When a request travels through a direct service binding where the hostname is not actually used for routing, use a sentinel internal hostname rather than a real external URL.
fix_shape: replace the real external endpoint string with an internal/placeholder hostname

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the platform's standard interface method (e.g. a `fetch` handler) instead of inventing a custom method name for the same purpose.
fix_shape: rename the custom method to the standard platform-recognized method name

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When a feature supports both streaming and non-streaming modes, add tests covering both code paths, not just one.
fix_shape: add a test exercising the streaming path alongside the existing non-streaming test

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Name a type-branding symbol `TypeId` (with a matching `type TypeId = typeof TypeId`) rather than an ad hoc name, following the codebase's convention for that pattern.
fix_shape: rename the branding symbol constant to the conventional `TypeId` pattern with its companion type alias

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A branding symbol property on an interface should be typed as the symbol's own type (a self-referential brand), not a boolean literal.
fix_shape: type the branded property as the symbol's TypeId type instead of `true`

author: wittjosiah
principle: Do not add a new deprecated method to a core interface when an existing method already covers the need; use the existing one instead.
fix_shape: remove the new (deprecated-on-arrival) method and call the existing equivalent API instead

author: wittjosiah
principle: Handle an event-driven condition by reacting to the actual triggering event rather than polling on an arbitrary fixed timer.
fix_shape: replace the setInterval poll with an event listener/callback tied to the real trigger

author: richburdon
principle: Keep CLI option/attribute help descriptions brief, without a trailing period.
fix_shape: shorten the description text and drop the trailing period

author: richburdon
principle: Keep CLI option help descriptions concise and state defaults directly rather than in lengthy phrasing.
fix_shape: rewrite the description more concisely, stating the default inline

author: richburdon
principle: Keep prompt/message text separate from interpolated data values rather than embedding data inline in the sentence.
fix_shape: format the prompt so the label and the data value are shown separately (e.g. on their own line or in brackets) instead of splicing the value into the sentence

author: richburdon
principle: Include the relevant identifier in an error message so a failure can be traced to the specific object involved.
fix_shape: interpolate the id/key into the error message instead of a generic statement

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Prefer `Effect.fn`/`Effect.fnUntraced` over manually wrapping `Effect.gen` in an arrow function for defining Effect-returning handlers.
fix_shape: wrap the generator body with Effect.fnUntraced (or Effect.fn) instead of `(args) => Effect.gen(function* () {...})`

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Provide a shorthand helper function wrapping a repeated service-access-then-call pattern instead of requiring every call site to yield* the service tag and then invoke a method.
fix_shape: add a module-level helper (e.g. `Service.method(...)`) that internally does the yield* + call, and use it at call sites

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not add a second mechanism for invoking/scheduling work that duplicates an existing one; combine them into a single parameterized mechanism instead.
fix_shape: merge the two invocation/scheduling paths into one API parameterized by timing/wait behavior (now/later, wait/no-wait)
